static_traits.name: Wen Wenlin
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before; no similar problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, Neutral attitude, willing to cooperate with recording and practice; able to describe distress and impact concretely

basic_info.main_problem: I constantly believe my pizza order will go wrong, which leads to Frustration and disappointment, and affects mood and daily life.
basic_info.core_demands: I hope this can help me reduce my constant worrying.
growth_experiences: Starting gender transition at 17, experiencing great stress and social judgment. The client believes the stress and judged experience of this period may have fueled their Anticipation that the outside world is unreliable and things will go wrong, a pattern that has since continued long-term in the specific scenario of ordering pizza (anticipating errors almost every order).

core_beliefs: Bad outcomes more likely to occur
Others or service systems are unreliable, needing to stay vigilant at all times

special_situations.event: Before ordering pizza (preparing to order via App or phone)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not repeatedly confirm and provide very specific instructions, the order will definitely go wrong
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly double-checks orders, gives very specific ordering instructions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will probably get my order wrong.

special_situations.event: While waiting for delivery after placing an order
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not predict the worst case in advance, it will be harder to bear when errors really occur
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly rehearsing negative outcomes in the mind, staying highly vigilant
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time it will most likely go wrong; just wait and see where the problem appears.

special_situations.event: Received the pizza and checked that it was actually correct
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One correct time does not prove anything, next time it will likely go wrong again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplays positive outcomes, puts attention on the next possible mistake to stay alert
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time was right, but next time will surely be wrong.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is even one mistake, it proves that ordering pizza is either perfect or a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Treats this mistake as solid evidence, further reducing trust and strengthening prior control and checking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As expected, they will just mess things up; ordering pizza is either completely right or a failure.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be truthfully understood and respected (treated correctly, identity accepted)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged, ignored, or mistaken (experiencing identity / needs being negated again)
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of disappointment and being negated through anticipating errors in advance and tight control
Staying vigilant to ensure a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: A service recipient who is easily overlooked and needs to maintain high vigilance
object_relations.object_representation: Others / systems that may be careless, unreliable, prone to errors

manifestations: Although having supportive friends, unwilling to share because feeling this issue is 'too strange', worrying about being seen as overreacting
After experiencing social judgment, more inclined to internalize worries into persistent Anticipation of errors
outcomes: Low mood and daily Decline in sense of well-being

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Unwilling to share specific distress for fear of friends seeing oneself as overreacting
Even when social support is available, still choosing to conceal and digest alone

exception_events.target_problem: When ordering pizza, the client typically Anticipates the order will definitely go wrong, causing strong worry and affected mood.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At the most recent ordering of food, the order was in fact correct, and the client at that moment experienced some relief of 'a sigh of relief' (though afterward it was still covered over by worry about the next time).
exception_events.reason: Different situation: the actual result was correct that time; different actions: the client double-confirmed and provided specific instructions.

positive_force: Having a supportive friend network (though not yet seeking support on this topic)
Able to notice the factual evidence that 'most of the time the order is correct'
Willing to try cognitive-behavioral strategies such as reality testing and recording predictions and outcomes
negative_force: Cognitive biases like predicting the future, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking maintaining worry
Stable belief that external systems / others are unreliable
Reducing help-seeking and sharing due to worrying about others' evaluation, weakening the use of Social support

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly Anticipating the order will go wrong and persistent worry in pizza-ordering situations (accompanied by Frustration and disappointment)
antecedent: While waiting for delivery after placing an order
After receiving the correct order, still associates it with 'next time it might go wrong'
target_behavior.core_reason: Enduring stress and social judgment during gender transition, forming beliefs that others / systems are unreliable and Bad outcomes more likely to occur, causing stable negative predictions in service scenarios.
target_behavior.function: Gaining some sense of control and security through anticipating in advance and mental preparation, trying to reduce the impact of potential disappointment.
target_behavior.consequence: Mood affected, daily Decline in sense of well-being, and more easily irritable in interactions with others.
